ops.rationale: The authors' given names are those of the Crossref record and the publisher BibTeX of DOI 10.1016/j.knosys.2018.09.001 (He, Hong; Tan, Yonghong; Xing, Jianfeng); every other field already agrees with that record.
The first author is H. Brendan McMahan in the arXiv record and in the paper's own author line; the entry dropped the initial H.

The doi field held an escaped underscore, so the identifier did not resolve; the bare DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-37456-2_14 is the one Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar resolve, and the style prints it inside \path and \href, which take a plain underscore.
